openai.sample_unit: prompting variants using one mock dental practice

links.effect: With structured Variant 2, ChatGPT asked for further information when questions were missed; no numeric effect reported.
links.quote: The AI tool requested further information when some questions were missed.

links.effect: Variant 2 provided 12 tailored recommendations, but none were referenced.
links.quote: However, none of these were referenced (see Figure 2 and Figure 3 ).

links.effect: Variant 3 produced 17 tailored recommendations and cited CSH plus Wikipedia despite instruction to rely solely on the CSH guide.
links.quote: Variant 3 provided 17 tailored recommendations referencing the centre for sustainable healthcare resource but also Wikipedia 12 , 16 (see Figure 4 ).

links.effect: Waste differed (Chat 232.2 kg vs Excel 246.1 kg); energy, water and procurement were identical; transport/waste breakdowns were missing.
links.quote: In Table 4 , Chat-based outputs are largely aligned with Excel calculations, though minor discrepancies were noted – particularly in waste emissions (Chat: 232.2 kg vs Excel: 246.1 kg).

links.effect: Variant 1 produced no specific footprint; Variant 2 provided 12 recommendations; Variant 3 provided 17; Chat waste estimate 232.2 kg versus Excel 246.1 kg.
links.quote: Structured prompts improved both accuracy and specificity.

unlisted_practices: Using ChatGPT as a carbon-footprint calculator for dental-practice sustainability planning

links.outcome: carbon footprint accuracy and recommendation specificity
links.effect: Structured prompts yielded 32.86 tonnes CO2e matching the Excel benchmark (32,850.4 kg) and tailored recommendations, whereas unstructured prompts failed to generate a practice-specific footprint.
links.quote: Structured prompts improved both accuracy and specificity.

links.outcome: sustainability recommendation quality and source grounding
links.effect: Restricting ChatGPT to an external sustainability guide (Variant 3) produced 17 recommendations referencing the guide and Wikipedia, showing little difference compared to ungrounded Variant 2 (12 recommendations).
links.quote: Despite there being little difference between the recommendations in Variant 2 and 3, it is the author’s opinion that a ChatGPT tool should be prompted with open access trusted references to draw on for personalised recommendations.
